rationale: Price has consolidated in a 0.45-point range across the last five 1-minute candles with mixed closes and no sustained push above the 9-EMA or away from session VWAP. The 53-bp bid-ask spread consumes a large fraction of the remaining 9-minute window before mandatory flat close, leaving no mechanical edge where a stop can be placed beyond immediate noise while still offering a reachable target on the other side. Elevated relative volume and 73.7% position in the day's range are acknowledged but currently lack directional follow-through.
